content_sections.heading: About APEDA
content_sections.text: APEDA is an autonomous organisation under the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. The notice says it is mandated with the promotion of agricultural and processed food products from India and works to improve market access for Indian agricultural products at the international level. Its work includes addressing Sanitary and Phyto-Sanitary (SPS) and Technical Barriers to Trade (TBT) issues. The post is in APEDA Head Office, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go by email to [email protected] . The notice makes it mandatory to mention the position applied for. It does not print a subject line. The application must be typed and signed, in the prescribed format attached to the notice (pages 5 and 6). The notice states that the application should be submitted strictly in the prescribed format only. The form is addressed to: The Secretary, APEDA, 3rd Floor, 3 Siri Institutional Area August Kranti Marg, Hauz Khas, New Delhi - 110 016. The notice states 18 November 2026 by 1700 hrs as the last date of submission of application. It does not say whether this is for receipt or dispatch. A candidate shall submit only one application. Submitting more than one may lead to rejection. Along with the application, send the scan CV and self-attested copies of the relevant documents.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential: MBA in Agribusiness Management/ Marketing/ International Business/ Entrepreneurship. Essential: Minimum 3 years of experience in related field. Desirable: Experience in training/ capacity building. Desirable: Engagement with startups, FPOs etc. Desirable: Conducting events. The notice prints an upper age limit of 50 years for the position of Associate. It does not print a minimum age, an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. The remuneration is inclusive of all applicable taxes, and no other facility or allowance will be allowed. While on tour, TA/DA is admissible to officials at Pay Level 10 of the Central Government. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail of the post.

rows.post: Associate (Northeast Region), place of posting New Delhi

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Signed and typed application in the prescribed format. Scan CV. Self-attested copies of the relevant documents. Self-attested copy of proof of age (as marked on the form). Self-attested copy of the essential educational qualification (as marked on the form). Self-attested copy of the experience certificate (as marked on the form). Recent passport size photograph, pasted on the form. The form asks for name in block letters, father's or husband's name, permanent and correspondence addresses, contact number and email ID, date of birth, nationality, educational and professional qualifications, post-qualification work experience, languages known and any other relevant information. It ends with the candidate's signature, date and place.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says only shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email for the interview. Mere submission of an application does not give any right to be called for interview. The notice does not describe the shortlisting method or how the interview is conducted.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The engagement is at the level of Associate and is purely on a contractual basis. The engagement is initially for one year, including a probation period of three weeks. It may be extended year-to-year depending on performance evaluation. After three years no further extension is permissible under any circumstances. The period of engagement commences from the date of joining at APEDA. It confers no claim or right to subsequent engagement or employment with APEDA or any other Government Department. Working hours are normally 9.00 AM to 5.30 PM on working days, including a half-hour lunch break. In exigencies of work the Associate may be required to sit late and to work on Saturday, Sunday and other holidays. The Associate is eligible for 20 days of leave in a year on pro-rata basis, with prior written approval of the controlling officer. Un-availed leave cannot be carried forward. Leave up to one month without remuneration can be considered with prior approval. A female Associate may be eligible for maternity leave as per the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017. The engagement can be terminated at any time by APEDA with 30 days' notice or pay in lieu. The Associate may also resign after giving similar notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The competent authority may cancel any application or candidature at its discretion, and no correspondence will be entertained. Wrong declaration or false information leads to cancellation of candidature at any stage. If documents are found false after engagement, the engagement will be terminated immediately. APEDA may require a Statement of Good Health from a recognised physician before work starts. Before engagement, the Associate must submit a police verification report from the concerned police station and a medical-cum-fitness certificate from an authorised Medical Practitioner. The Associate will be governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923, and must not use APEDA's name, emblem or official seal without prior written permission. In case of death, injury or illness while serving APEDA, the Associate or next of kin is not entitled to any compensation or appointment. The Associate must comply with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the APEDA Associate (Northeast Region) recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, with New Delhi as the place of posting. The competent authority reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies as required.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for APEDA Associate (Northeast Region)?
faq.answer: The last date of submission of application is 18 November 2026 by 1700 hrs. The application must be sent by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for APEDA Associate (Northeast Region)?
faq.answer: Essential qualification is an MBA in Agribusiness Management/ Marketing/ International Business/ Entrepreneurship, plus minimum 3 years of experience in related field. Experience in training/ capacity building, engagement with startups, FPOs etc. and conducting events are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the APEDA Associate post?
faq.answer: The notice prints an upper age limit of 50 years for the position of Associate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of APEDA Associate (Northeast Region)?
faq.answer: The remuneration ranges from Rs. 80,000/- to Rs. 1,05,000/- per month. It is inclusive of all applicable taxes, and no other facility or allowance will be allowed.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the APEDA Associate post?
faq.answer: Send a signed and typed application in the prescribed format, with a scan CV and self-attested copies of the relevant documents, by email to [email protected]. It is mandatory to mention the position applied for.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for APEDA Associate?
faq.answer: The notice says only shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email for the interview. Mere submission of an application gives no right to be called for interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the APEDA Associate job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely on a contractual basis. It is initially for one year, including a probation period of three weeks. It may be extended year-to-year depending on performance evaluation, and no extension is permissible after three years.

faq.question: Q9. Can I send more than one application for the APEDA Associate post?
faq.answer: A candidate shall submit only one application. Submission of more than one application may lead to rejection.
